title: Dominique Giant Feet - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Dominique Giant Feet in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: An Arena opponent in the Hidden Gestral Arena, part of the same tournament chain as Matthieu the Colossus and Julien Tiny Head. Like the rest of the set it is a 1v1 skill check with no elemental puzzle.

sections.title: How to Beat the Dominique Giant Feet
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.

No elemental shortcut

With no weakness to exploit, the fight is decided by your upgrade levels and your parry timing. Check that your weapons are current before attempting it.
